tasks.experiment: mc_calibration with gamma=0 for both classes, larger n_sims, different seed
tasks.question: Does the day-clustered Wald test hold nominal size with more sims (e.g. several hundred)?
tasks.why: n=16 cannot distinguish 12.5% from 5% reliably; the cluster rejection rate and coverage need tighter bounds.

tasks.experiment: mc_calibration with level_sd varied, still gamma=0
tasks.question: How does robust and cluster size vary with level_sd (day-level shock size) and with the number of event windows?
tasks.why: Inference is identified by event windows, not trades; this checks how the SE understatement scales.

tasks.question: Which inference procedure does the pre-registration specify for criterion (2), and does the code path used for the real data apply day-clustered or placebo-based inference?
tasks.why: The trade-level robust test is shown oversized here, so criterion (2) must not rely on it alone.

tasks.why: Quantifies the impact of the A1-5 gap on the reported long-run effects and on the placebo and offset-scan criteria.
